facility.name: Childrens Lighthouse of Corinth
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1560 POST OAK DR, CORINTH, TX, 76210

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Parent's Written Permission for Powders, Lotions, Etc.: Based on information gathered during the investigation, it was determined that caregivers used creams that were not provided by the parent, and the operation did not have permission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Parent's Written Permission for Powders, Lotions, Etc. (26 TAC §746.3501(4))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The operation did not provide parents of children with incident reports for situations that occurred while the children were in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation: Based on the information gathered through the investigation, the directors and caregivers were aware of multiple claims of suspected abuse and/or neglect and failed to report to the appropriate authorities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation (26 TAC §746.1201(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection conducted at the operation was 12/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Two caregivers in Room 9 did not know the number of children present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information gathered during an investigation, the school-age caregiver open-handedly pushed a child in the face to turn them away from her, while the child was trying to communicate with the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on information gathered during investigtion mangagment did not report an incident that placed a child at risk, in which they were knowledgeable.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on information gathered during an investigation, the school-age caregiver has yelled at the children while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The operation did not provide a child's parent with an incident report for situations that occurred while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on information gathered during the course of the investigation, a director has not been reporting situations that place children at risk to CCR and has not ensured that they are operating to minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on information gathered through an investigation, the school-age caregiver grabbed a child by the arm while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Initial background checks submitted - At the time you submit your application: A caregiver was present in the classroom caring for children without an active background check on file.   The staff was sent home during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Initial background checks submitted - At the time you submit your application (26 TAC §745.621(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: Notification was not provided to the parent by pick-up time concerning an incident that caused the child's teeth to become chipped.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior: Based on the DFPS investigation, a caregiver did not use appropriate redirection as the caregiver grabbed a child by the wrist and lifted the child from a seated position to direct the child to the sink.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One caregiver was missing an up to date CPR/First Aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: During the inspection, there were infant bottles observed with the first name and no last initial.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: The operation did not have a background check submitted for a caregiver working at the center. The background check was ran while at the inspection and the caregiver was sent home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The employee list was observed posted but was not updated with the current staff. The list was last updated on 1/25/25.   This was corrected at inspection when an updated employee list was made and posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined that a caregiver did not use good judgement when not checking the bottles to verify the name, which resulted in an infant being fed the wrong bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: It was determined that the operation did not report to CCR that a caregiver gave an infant another infant's bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: It was determined that an incident report was not signed by the parents after a child was injured while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Use Clear, Positive Statements: It was determined that the staff did not correct a pattern of behavior when a child continued to climb up the slide and jump off, which caused the child to injure themselves.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Use Clear, Positive Statements (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(B))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Three staff are missing the annual 24 hours for the last full year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Three caregivers witnessed an incident where a child required medical attention, and did not adequately intervene.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: Based on evidence obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver grabbed a child by the arm as a form of redirection rather than using positive statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: A 3 year old child was left unattended in the classroom for approximately 8 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not demonstrate good judgment when not correcting children on how to properly use the outside play structure equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was observed sleeping in a swing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: The 11 months to 24 months class was observed outside on the playground out of ratio. There were 2 caregivers and 14 children with a specified age group of 11months to 18months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages: During the inspection, three staff did not know the childrens ages that they were caring for and were unable to obtain the information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §746.1203(3))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: A child was placed at risk when being able to get out from the playground gate and walk to the front of the building and was left unsupervised. The parents were not notified until 2 hours later.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: It was determined a child was able to get out from the playground gate and walked to the front of the building. The child was unsupervised for approximately less than five minutes. The child was found by a parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based on information obtained it was determined that three classrooms were out ratios for more than 30 minutes. The three classrooms out of ratio were Room 6, Room 7, and Room 8.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: Based on the information obtained, classrooms were out of ratio while the owner was in charge of the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The operation allowed a caregiver to have access to children without obtaining the results of the background check. The caregiver was sent home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not report to Child Care Regulation that a child was left in a classroom unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One caregiver does not have current training in CPR since October 2021. In addition it was determined that three staff were supervising children alone while not having CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One caregiver does not have current training in first aid since October 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - Contact EMS or take to ER: On two separate occasions a child had a seizure and the operation did not contact EMS for the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - Contact EMS or take to ER (26 TAC §746.3605(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the evidence obtained, it was determined that the director has lied about incidents occurring at the operation such as children having seizures, children being injured in care, and children being left unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: During interviews, it was determined that a child was left unsupervised in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not have an incident report for a child being left unsupervised in a classroom. The operation did not have incident reports for a child having two seizures at the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The 2 year old class was observed out of ratio outside with 1 caregiver and 12 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver in the infant classroom was observed not washing hands after diapering a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: The operation did not use the proper cleaning solution when cleaning the floors. The product used was not designed to be used on flooring.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: During an investigation inspection  on 2/22/2022 an infant was observed sleeping in a crib with a pacifier clip connected to the shirt.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: During the course of an investigation, video footage was observed and a caregiver did not wash their hands after changing children's diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: During the course of an investigation, video footage was observed showing children in a classroom not washing their hands after having diapers changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))
